name: Entryway Tile for Pacific Northwest Winters
title-tag: Entryway Tile for PNW Winters | Edmonds, WA
meta-description: Grit, rain, and dark months decide an entry floor. Specifying entryway tile for Pacific Northwest winters: texture, color, mats, and the hardwood transition.
post-summary: December 8, 2026 · From October to May, every arrival delivers water and grit to your entry floor - and grit is what kills the hardwood beyond it. Here is how to build a tiled landing zone that actually works: textured matte porcelain, a membrane underneath, a 4-6 foot depth, a flush transition to the wood, and the two-mat system that does the absorbent half of the job.
